demos.items.storeBoundary.description.message: Uses a fresh food supplier form to verify that Ant Design Form manages field values, while effects update field values or DynamicForm meta.

demos.items.customHandlers.description.message: Uses independent field examples to show how custom EffectResultHandler implementations update values, field meta, and dynamic styles; it is not a single business workflow.

demos.items.customComponents.description.message: Uses custom component examples to show component registration and detail-view rendering; the fields demonstrate component capabilities rather than a single business workflow.

demos.items.formValidation.description.message: Shows how standard fields and complex Form.List components share Ant Design Form validation.

demos.items.uiConfig.description.message: Uses a ticket form to show how static uiConfig merges with dynamic UI config returned by effects.

demos.items.renderExtension.description.message: Shows render extension parameters and custom component registration extension points.

demos.items.compilerFoundation.descripti.message: Shows how metadata adapter converts request field modules into standard FormConfig for DynamicForm to render.

demos.items.compilerFoundation.presentat.message: The compiled request form contains title, department, priority, and budget fields; selecting Engineering reveals the conditional review group.

demos.items.nodeModel4.description.message: Shows 4.0 nodes, standard containers, nested containers, repeatable containers, cascading field interactions, and cross-level effect graphs; the business-customer switch controls company details and contacts.

demos.items.headlessRenderer.description.message: Shows createMemoryFormAdapter, headlessRenderer, nested names, hidden fields, and render hooks overriding defaultRender.

demos.client.description.message: Select a demo to inspect the interactive behavior.

demos.sourcePanel.multiFileHint.message: Use the file tabs to switch between sources. Copying copies only the selected file.

demos.sourcePanel.mountDescription.message: This example assumes App.tsx is at the repository root. It imports the current component from ./demos, renders it as a React component, and mounts it to #root.

demos.sourcePanel.sharedContext.message: DemoWrapper presents the site demo; demos reuse DemoLoading and useDemoSubmitResult. The links below open this demo, related components, and the submit result helper.
demos.sourcePanel.sharedContext.description: Context note above GitHub source links

demos.sourcePanel.githubLinks.description: Label for GitHub links to the demo and its custom components

demos.guide.storeBoundary.employeeCount.message: Change the employee count and observe the value in the Form values panel.

demos.guide.storeBoundary.formValue.message: Inspect the live Form values panel to confirm Ant Design Form owns field values.

demos.guide.storeBoundary.meta.message: Change supplier type and observe industry, production details, and disabled revenue fields.

demos.guide.storeBoundary.groupVisibilit.message: Toggle fields to verify group visibility and dependent region options.

demos.guide.customHandlers.name.message: Change the name from a regular value to admin and back to observe the background color.

demos.guide.customHandlers.age.message: Enter an age and observe the data transform handler double the number.

demos.guide.customHandlers.email.message: Enter an invalid email and observe the note field hide and its submitted value clear.

demos.guide.customHandlers.status.message: Change the status and observe chained styling and data transformation.

demos.guide.customComponents.viewMode.message: Switch among the three modes. In Custom Rendering, the avatar upload keeps its original component to show an exception to the custom read-only display.

demos.guide.customComponents.visibility.message: Toggle Show extra information to verify custom field visibility.

demos.guide.customComponents.registry.message: Use the fields in Interactive Controls mode, submit, and inspect the form data in the modal.

demos.guide.formValidation.standard.message: Check required, length, and email format rules on standard fields.

demos.guide.formValidation.custom.message: Choose project delivery platforms and technologies, then add or remove members and tasks to verify complex Form.List rules.

demos.guide.formValidation.actions.message: Fill in the validation error example and validate to inspect errors; fix them and validate again, or reset the form.

demos.guide.uiConfig.global.message: Change the status field and observe dynamic global UIConfig changes.

demos.guide.uiConfig.field.message: Change the priority field and observe its field-level label and UI config.

demos.guide.uiConfig.priority.message: Compare field-level, dynamic global, and static global config precedence.

demos.guide.renderExtension.field.message: Switch between default rendering and the extension example to compare the region markers added by render hooks.

demos.guide.renderExtension.fields.message: renderFields adds a custom container around the field collection.

demos.guide.renderExtension.groups.message: renderGroups switches group presentation to Tabs.

demos.guide.renderExtension.form.message: renderFormInner customizes the form submit button.

demos.guide.compilerFoundation.modules.message: Observe how modules such as TextField and DepartmentPicker compile into standard fields.

demos.guide.compilerFoundation.override.message: Select Engineering to show the review group, then switch departments to hide it.

demos.guide.compilerFoundation.submit.message: Submit the form and inspect the data passed to onSubmit in the modal.

demos.guide.nodeModel4.container.message: Toggle Company customer to show or hide company details and contacts together; contact controls also hide when the list is hidden.

demos.guide.nodeModel4.parentChild.message: Change legal entity type and observe the nested address usage default and options.

demos.guide.nodeModel4.cascade.message: Change the province and city to observe cascading city and district updates.

demos.guide.headlessRenderer.fields.message: Change the nested name and email fields.

demos.guide.headlessRenderer.submit.message: Submit the form and inspect the values returned by the Memory Adapter.

demos.guide.headlessRenderer.hidden.message: Confirm the initially hidden note is absent from the fields and submit result, and inspect the custom field wrapper.

api.groups.components.description.message: Render a form from a hand-written config or converted config.

api.groups.hooks.description.message: Register interaction handlers or access form context from custom extensions.

api.groups.configTypes.description.message: Describe fields, groups, submitted values, and form presentation settings.

api.groups.corePackage.description.message: Config, compiler, rules, diagnostics, and pure Runtime APIs that can be consumed directly from @whynotsnow/dynamic-form-core starting in 4.2.

api.groups.formRendererAdapters.descript.message: Connect a form instance, replace the default presentation, or register custom field components.

api.groups.componentRegistry.description.message: Register or extend field components and access the default Ant Design component set.

api.groups.compilerModules.description.message: Compile domain field modules into standard FormConfig while preserving the runtime rendering pipeline.

api.groups.adapters.description.message: Convert field modules, JSON Schema, OpenAPI, or metadata into DynamicForm config.

api.groups.rules.description.message: Define synchronous rules and convert them into interaction results DynamicForm can handle.

api.groups.fieldAddress.description.message: Separates stable field ids from Ant Design NamePath and supports nested value paths.

api.groups.runtimeInspection.description.message: Handle nested field paths or check whether fields are displayed, submitted, or validated.

api.groups.utilities.description.message: Check config and query whether fields are displayed, submitted, or validated.

api.groups.coreConfig.description.message: Find config issues or prepare the information needed to display a form.

api.groups.coreCompiler.description.message: Convert reusable field modules or external schemas into form config.

api.groups.coreTypes.description.message: TypeScript types for form config, fields, rules, and runtime state.

api.package.react.description.message: Render and use forms in React applications. This package also re-exports commonly used core config APIs for existing imports.

api.package.core.description.message: Check, convert, or inspect form config without rendering a React form, such as in a visual builder, server task, or build script.

api.layout.description.message: A summary of commonly used exports, grouped by package.

api.page.description.message: This page lists commonly used APIs from both packages to help you choose an import path. It is not a complete export list; check the package for full exports and type details.

examples.minimal.description.message: Set up basic fields with fields. DynamicForm uses Ant Design to display the form by default.

examples.grouped.description.message: Put related fields in one group. They appear in a section card by default; adjust the layout when needed.

examples.effects.description.message: Show or hide the company name field based on whether the user has a company.

examples.customComponents.description.message: Register a custom input in componentRegistry, then refer to it from the field config.

examples.customHandlers.description.message: Use a custom handler for business-specific interaction results; the field component still handles display and input.

examples.compilerAdapter.description.message: Convert JSON Schema, OpenAPI, or your own data format into config that DynamicForm can display.

examples.layout.description.message: Scenario-based DynamicForm config examples with docs and demo showcase links.

examples.page.description.message: Find a starting point by scenario. Each example is a short snippet with links to the full guide and an interactive demo.

marketplace.layout.description.message: Browse built-in DynamicForm features and example code for custom extensions.

marketplace.installMode.builtin.descript.message: Use built-in field components directly in field config. Call useInitHandlers({}) to register the built-in interaction handlers.

marketplace.installMode.copy.description.message: Copy the example code and register it with DynamicForm. Adapt data and business logic for your project.

marketplace.page.description.message: Browse built-in fields and interaction handlers, or copy custom component, handler, and recipe examples as a starting point. These are code examples, not installable plugin packages; add your own data requests and business logic.

marketplace.detail.layout.description.message: Explore previews, usage guidance, and code snippets for DynamicForm extension examples.

marketplace.detail.notFoundDescription.message: This link points to an extension entry that does not exist. It may have been renamed or removed.

marketplace.detail.previewMissing.message: No interactive preview is available for this entry yet.

marketplace.preview.emptyDescription.message: The page does not mount all previews by default. Click an item's Preview button to render the matching real DynamicForm example here.

marketplace.data.builtinComponent.descri.message: Built-in field component. Reference it directly in the component field of your form config.

marketplace.data.builtinHandler.descript.message: Built-in interaction handler. Call useInitHandlers({}) to register it, then use its result name in an effect.

marketplace.data.remoteSelect.descriptio.message: A searchable select example using local sample data. Add your own request logic and update the options to connect a service.

marketplace.data.userPicker.description.message: Shows an avatar picker with a fixed sample user list, as a starting point for owner or approver fields.

marketplace.data.editableTable.descripti.message: Wraps an editable detail table field for order lines, expense details, and task breakdowns.

marketplace.data.toast.description.message: Converts effect results into lightweight message feedback for pre-save hints or interaction feedback.

marketplace.data.highlight.description.message: Converts the business semantic highlight into field render meta for important-field hints.

marketplace.data.fieldErrors.description.message: Writes server-side field errors into Ant Design Form for business validation feedback before or after submit.

marketplace.recipe.remoteSearch.descript.message: Use SearchSelectField to filter local sample options and register it through componentRegistry. Add request logic to connect a service.

marketplace.recipe.approverPicker.descri.message: Use UserPickerField to provide person selection for approval or task workflows.

marketplace.recipe.editableTable.descrip.message: Use EditableTableField to maintain structured detail rows inside a form.

homepage.features.configDriven.descripti.message: Describe fields, groups, validation, and UI config with FormConfig, keeping Ant Design Form usage behind a stable configuration layer.

homepage.features.effectsRuntime.descrip.message: Execute dependency chains through @whynotsnow/hooks/form-chain-effect and resolve rendering, submit, disabled, readonly, and validation capabilities through the Runtime Layer.

homepage.features.extensionPoints.descri.message: Supports custom components, effect result handlers, render hooks, compiler, adapters, and a declarative rule layer.

homepage.flow.adapterCompiler.descriptio.message: Normalize external schemas, metadata, or field modules into standard FormConfig.

homepage.flow.stateRuntime.description.message: Store structure and meta, then resolve rendered, editable, validatable, and related capabilities in one place.

homepage.flow.consumerEffects.descriptio.message: Render Ant Design Form and route field effect results through semantic handlers.

homepage.paths.start.description.message: Start from installation, minimal config, and field config to run your first DynamicForm.

homepage.paths.examples.description.message: Find examples for minimal forms, groups, effects, custom components, and the compiler pipeline.

homepage.paths.demos.description.message: Run existing demos directly to inspect form effects, validation, render hooks, and extension behavior.

homepage.paths.api.description.message: Review public exports grouped by components, hooks, compiler, adapters, rules, and types.

homepage.layout.description.message: DynamicForm is a dynamic form library built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design.

homepage.hero.subtitle.message: A dynamic form library built with React, TypeScript, and Ant Design. Describe form structure with config, handle field dependencies with effect chains, and centralize runtime participation policy in the Runtime Layer.

homepage.workflow.description.message: DynamicForm separates input normalization, runtime capabilities, and UI rendering into clear layers for reuse, extension, and verification.

homepage.paths.description.message: The site is organized around quick start, config examples, demo showcase, and exported APIs.

demos.layout.description.message: Interactive DynamicForm demos powered by the shared demo registry.
